session.capture_method: Native Codex JSONL events plus timed copies; preload snapshots before CLI entry and 50ms polling for complete output JSON revisions. Transient unsubmitted drafts between polls are not guaranteed.
session.completeness: Native JSONL stream through process exit; tool output truncation, if any, remains visible; private reasoning is not requested.

observations.review_origin: Author-side pinned-source and final JSON review plus native 1440x900 capture inspection.
findings: Inspection and planning persist control state but do not execute Skill-content mutations. Discovery is separate from mutation authority.
Apply and Undo are explicit commands with live-state rechecks; Undo reverses stored receipt compensations, not a new semantic plan. JSON mode does not enforce an extra confirmation prompt.
Filesystem journals and SQLite are distinct persistence layers; failure/recovery limitations are disclosed.
One voluntary revision removed a redundant boundary after passing validation. Two failed lookup commands came from nonexistent paths/globs, not diagram diagnostics.
No new direction or label-arrow field was used. Unchanged final bytes deliver with identical layout and SVG on both versions.
observations.tool_count_definition: Completed shell command-execution items; compound shell subcommands are not counted independently. Native sessions retain their output and failures.
